details:
Project Details – AgriCycle

AgriCycle is a technology-driven agricultural platform designed to help farmers make informed decisions about crop rotation and sustainable farming. It works by collecting information about a farmer's geographical location, farm conditions, and previous crops to provide suitable crop rotation recommendations. The platform aims to help farmers maintain soil fertility, reduce the risks associated with repeated cultivation of the same crops, and improve long-term agricultural productivity.

AgriCycle integrates geographical data and NASA satellite-based Earth observation resources to support more informed agricultural decisions. Farmers can access the platform through a simple, user-friendly interface, enter their farm details, and explore recommendations relevant to their land and location.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, alongside satellite data resources and web-based technologies. Particular attention was given to accessibility, simplicity, and the needs of farmers who may have limited experience with digital tools.

What makes AgriCycle creative is its combination of space technology and practical agriculture. Instead of treating satellite data as purely scientific information, the project explores how it can be transformed into useful guidance for everyday farming decisions.

Our team considered several factors, including geographical differences, seasonal suitability, soil health, crop diversity, accessibility, and the practical challenges faced by farmers. Ultimately, AgriCycle aims to encourage sustainable agricultural practices, support better land management, and contribute to food security by making technology more accessible to the agricultural community.
